thread:
Alex: heads-up — us-south1 GPU attach queue is backed up, attach-waits climbing. seeing sustained write-tail spikes on local NVMe (mixed firmware in same rack) and high iowait.
Maya: on it. which hosts and quick logs?
Alex: gnode-us-south1-12..19. dmesg has write timeout lines. iostat snapshot:
```
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s   r/s   w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz  await r_await w_await svctm  %util
nvme0n1         0.00  25.00  12.4  540.0  98.0  27680   100.0    10.2   148.3   8.6  160.1  1.85  99.7
```
Also overlayfs snapshot churn from background cleanup.
Sam: that looks like tiny-write hot path + janitor compaction. mixed firmware amplifies tail latency.
Ops-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3141 - "storage write-tail causing GPU attach holds (us-south1)". Pager: eng-oncall.
Teja: mitigation: throttle janitor and snapshot cadence on affected nodes, or migrate batch jobs off mixed racks. suggest janitor.rate=0.5 and snapshot cadence -> 10m.
Dmitri: prefer throttling not stop. stopping janitor risks tempfile accumulation. do: systemctl set-property janitor.service CPUQuota=50% + janitor.rate=0.5 for a few hours.
Maya: applied janitor.rate=0.4 and reduced snapshot cadence on 8 hosts. attach success up 40% -> 92% in 5m.
Alex: also disabled per-node overlayfs snapshots on two worst hosts and remounted writable. attach latency dropped sharply.
Sam: postmortem items: create perf test reproducing 4k random writes + overlayfs snapshot + janitor compaction on mixed-firmware nvme; capture fio and blktrace; investigate whether firmware GC or host-side queueing is dominant.
Maya: added remediation to INC-2026-3141: cordon mixed nodes for big batch work, schedule firmware parity update, add alert for avgqu-sz>5 for >2m.
Alex: rolling migration ongoing. will update runbooks. :thumbsup:
